headline: Tigers set 275-run target for Australia in 3rd ODI
summary: Towhid Hridoy's 83, along with fifties from Litton Das and Mosaddek Hossain, power Bangladesh to 274/5 in Mirpur.
details: Bangladesh posted a competitive total of 274/5 in the first innings of the third ODI against Australia in Mirpur, setting a target of 275 for the visitors.
Towhid Hridoy led the charge with a responsible 83, while Litton Das (58*) and Mosaddek Hossain (56*) provided crucial support with half-centuries.

caption:
274/5! The Tigers have set a challenging target for Australia in Mirpur.

Bangladesh posted a competitive total of 274/5 in the first innings of the third ODI against Australia in Mirpur, setting a target of 275 for the visitors.

Towhid Hridoy led the charge with a responsible 83, while Litton Das (58*) and Mosaddek Hossain (56*) provided crucial support with half-centuries.

The Tigers started poorly, sliding to 61-3 in the 15th over after Xavier Bartlett (2-42) and Matt Renshaw took early wickets of Soumya Sarkar, Tanzid Hasan, and Najmul Hossain Shanto.

A 95-run partnership for the fourth wicket between Litton and Hridoy stabilized the innings before Litton was forced to retire hurt due to an injury.

Hridoy then shared a 90-run stand with Mosaddek Hossain to push the total toward a respectable score before eventually falling to a deep midwicket catch.

A victory in this final match would secure a series whitewash for Bangladesh against Australia.

headline_marked: Bangladesh Bank [[loans 2,500 crore BDT to Islami Bank]] to ease liquidity
headline: Bangladesh Bank loans 2,500 crore BDT to Islami Bank to ease liquidity
summary: The central bank provided a special loan to help the bank resolve its cash crisis and resume check clearing services.
details: Bangladesh Bank has provided a special loan of 2,500 crore BDT to Islami Bank to address its ongoing liquidity crisis.
The decision was made by the central bank on Sunday morning to stabilize the bank's operations.
The funds were deposited directly into Islami Bank's current account maintained at Bangladesh Bank.
As a result of this financial injection, the bank has been able to resume its check clearing services.
The information was confirmed by sources from both Bangladesh Bank and Islami Bank.
caption:
2,500 crore BDT injected. Bangladesh Bank steps in to save Islami Bank's liquidity.

Bangladesh Bank has provided a special loan of 2,500 crore BDT to Islami Bank to address its ongoing liquidity crisis.

The decision was made by the central bank on Sunday morning to stabilize the bank's operations.

The funds were deposited directly into Islami Bank's current account maintained at Bangladesh Bank.

As a result of this financial injection, the bank has been able to resume its check clearing services.

The information was confirmed by sources from both Bangladesh Bank and Islami Bank.
